name: SeaQull
description: SQL Server client for Orca: browse databases, run queries in workbook tabs, copy and export results.

screenshots.alt: Completion offering a foreign-key join condition after ON, with a result grid below and the object explorer on the right
screenshots.caption: Completion with foreign-key joins, the result grid and the object explorer

screenshots.alt: The New connection dialog: name, colour, server and port, database, authentication, user and password, and encryption options
screenshots.caption: Adding a connection

settings.title: Row limit per result
settings.description: Rows kept per result set. Past it the batch is stopped, so a SELECT * on a huge table stays responsive. Exports contain the rows kept.

settings.title: Explorer position
settings.description: Which side of the SQL console the object explorer sits on.

settings.title: Azure CLI path
settings.description: Full path to az, for Microsoft Entra ID connections. Leave empty to search PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.
